events.title: Out of favour 아스널 striker Charlie Nicholas returns to his native Scotland in a £500,000 move to Aberdeen . Billy Bonds of 웨스트햄 유나이티드, the oldest Football League player at 41, is awarded an MBE .
John Wark returns to 입스위치 타운 from 리버풀 in a £100,000 deal.
Dave Bassett is sacked after just six months in charge of 왓퍼드, who are currently bottom of the First Division. He is succeeded by 애스턴 빌라 assistant manager Steve Harrison .
John Aldridge becomes the first player to reach the 20-goal mark in the First Division when he scores in 리버풀's 2–0 home win over 아스널.
옥스퍼드 유나이티드 , winners of the 1986 League Cup, reach the semi-finals of this season's competition with a surprise 2–0 win over 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the quarter-finals.
맨체스터 시티 boost their Second Division promotion challenge with a £175,000 move for 노샘프턴 타운 striker Trevor Morley .
아스널 pay 스토크 시티 £400,000 for 23-year-old right-back Lee Dixon .
애스턴 빌라 boost their Second Division promotion challenge with the £200,000 acquisition of highly rated 크루 알렉산드라 midfielder David Platt , 21.
FA Cup holders 코번트리 시티 are knocked out by 왓퍼드 in the fourth round. Last year's defeated finalists 토트넘 홋스퍼 are also eliminated, losing 2–1 at Third Division 포트 베일.

리버풀 remain top of the First Division as January draws to a close, now 16 points ahead of second-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 왓퍼드 and 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 make up the bottom three. 애스턴 빌라 have crept to the top of the Second Division, while 크리스털 팰리스 have risen to second place. 미들즈브러, 밀월 and 블랙번 로버스 occupy the play-off zone, while 브래드퍼드 시티 have slid from second to sixth place in the space of a few weeks. 레스터 시티, relegated from the First Division last season, are now in the Second Division relegation play-off places.
